description: Provenance hunt behind fz-go4.18.28.3 (measured at 0cb890e95 + .28.3 fix, via temp INTERN-SMELL instrumentation in TypeInterner::intern on 00277): 24 distinct descrs interned with smelly tuple DNFs — duplicate clauses (dnf_union dedups but intersect_dnf at mod.rs:1498 does NOT dedup its output product), multi-pos clauses (up to 45 clauses/descr), constructed by Types::intersect (15 hits) and Types::union (9 hits) from jobs/semantic.rs refine_call_return / refine_observed_return / join_evidence. Three concrete leaks, all at the Types persistence boundary where &mut interner access exists: (1) intersect_dnf does not dedup output clauses (A∨A=A) or drop P∧¬P clauses — the compiler2-side twin of the dnf.rs hygiene landed in .28.3; (2) TupleSig::intersect_pos (sigs.rs) merges same-arity tuples WITHOUT checking coordinate emptiness — unlike ListSig/ResourceSig which drop empty merges — so provably-empty clauses persist; arity-MISMATCHED pos pairs are pushed as 2-pos clauses (intersect_clauses mod.rs:1508 fallback) which are empty by construction yet persist and double every dnf_neg factor (the 20 two-pos clauses = 2^20 in the 00277 census); (3) the fz-et8 semantic subsumption post-pass at union (absorption A⊆B ⇒ A∨B=B, commit faab5ef5c) was dropped in the old-world->compiler2 port while its comment survived (see fz-go4.23) — near-duplicate evidence-join clauses accumulate unboundedly across fixpoint iterations (39 clauses, 15 distinct). ACCEPTANCE: an interned descr never carries a duplicate, provably-empty, or subsumed tuple clause (assert-worthy invariant at intern in debug); 00277's biggest interned tuple DNF drops from 45 clauses to the distinct-and-live count; emptiness answers unchanged (lib green, fixture outputs byte-identical). Relates: fz-go4.18.28.3 (downstream symptom fixed), fz-go4.23 (stale comment).
title: Types-layer persistence leaks garbage tuple clauses: duplicates, empty arity-mismatch multi-pos clauses, no subsumption (the 39-clause union behind the 00277 emptiness blowup)
